players.name: PhogsToffees

strengths.title: Getting shots off
strengths.coach: You kept finding ways to get shots off. Can't score 'em if you don't take 'em.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: 20/28 passes (71%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

players.headline: Strong forward performance (8.3, top 25% for the position) - best at getting shots off, goal threat; work on forcing passes.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: Now that's what I'm talking about, PhogsToffees. A 8.3 puts you in the top quarter of forwards.
coach.closer: Proud of you. Now go drink some water.

push.title: D 2-2 vs Scentless | You: 8.3 (top 25% FOR)
push.body:
Now that's what I'm talking about, PhogsToffees. An 8.3 puts you in the top quarter of forwards.

DID WELL
+ 5 shots at Scentless's goal. Fortune favors the folks who shoot.
+ A brace against Scentless. Scoring's a lot like karaoke: confidence is half of it.
+ 0.6 above your usual rating. That's growth, and growth is the whole point.
+ An 8.3 is top 25% stuff for a forward anywhere you look.
+ 2-2 with Scentless. Not the ending we wanted, but the story's still going.

WORK ON
- 71% passing (20 of 28). Real talk: Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
- Shots on target: 80%. Halfway up the mountain. The view from 90%+ is something else.
- Goals per shot on target: 50%. Good, not great yet; top-quarter forwards sit at 60%+.
- Key passes: 0. Decent, but top-quarter forwards get to 2+. That's the next rung.

Coach's drill: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.

Keep that up and I'll have to start buying bigger biscuit tins. - Coach Lasso

players.name: BellyTb1

strengths.title: Passing accuracy
strengths.note: Keeps possession reliably - teammates can trust the ball with them.
strengths.coach: Kept the ball like it owed you money.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 0 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

players.headline: Quiet midfielder performance (7.1, below average for the position) - best at passing accuracy, chance creation; work on defensive work rate.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: A 7.1 today, BellyTb1. Little below the line for a midfielder, but there's good stuff in here to work with.
coach.closer: Growth isn't a straight line. It's more like a squiggle. We're squiggling in the right direction.

push.title: D 2-2 vs Scentless | You: 7.1 (below average MID)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 7.1 is a quiet night for a midfielder. Quiet nights teach the loudest lessons.

DID WELL
+ 94% passing on 16 attempts, up from your usual 73%. Smooth as a fresh jar of peanut butter.
+ 1 assist. That's what I call neighborly football.
+ You & PhogsToffees clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ 2-2 with Scentless. A draw is a win that hasn't figured itself out yet.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
- 0.8 under your usual. That's a dip, not a trend. Promise.
- Passes attempted: 16. Middle of the pack for a midfielder; the top quarter hits 25+. Room to climb.

Before next match: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

Write one of these on your hand next match. I'm serious. - Coach Lasso

work_on.title: Playing forward
work_on.tip: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
